title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint: Side Story
altTitles: 全知读者视角 外传
全知讀者視角 外傳
description: The continuation of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint following the original 551-chapter novel. The side story begins with Lee Hakhyun, a webnovel author whose only major success is Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint, and expands the story into new worldlines and scenarios. Beginning from chapter 553, it explores Lee Hakhyun and the readers of his novel as they become involved with the world of Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse, while continuing the themes, characters, and mysteries of the original story.
author: Sing Shong
